x: The race was won by Roath of Walton(56:11)from Goode of Epsom with Baker of Horsham 3rd. Walker(59:28 9th),Moore(60.49,13th), and E.Bishop (62:12,16th) completed our scoring trio and they managed to snatch 3rd place from S.L.H. in what was a desperately close finish.
At the end of the first lap Roath (Walton) Snowden (Surrey) and Tony Milner (Walton) were contesting the lead with our own Gerry North a little way behind, but by no means out of touch.

Bill Kerr took the next stage of 5 miles against Lindsell of Portsmouth and Roath of Walton. Although running well enough to beat the previous stage record by 14 seconds, he could make no impression on the Portsmouth runner although closing slightly on Roath.
